text: Allow nurses to sign in via Azure AD SSO and display their assigned patients and pending notes from the previous shift within 3 seconds
Enable nurses to create and save ward notes with free-text content, patient selection, and optional timestamp override limited to the current shift
Synchronize each saved ward note to both the hospital’s FHIR-compliant EHR system and the legacy spreadsheet within 10 seconds
Generate and assign a unique, immutable UUIDv7 note ID to each ward note, included in all data stores and shown to the nurse upon save
Implement a status field on ward notes with values Pending Review, Discrepancy Identified, Resolved, and Escalated to track review and escalation workflow
Allow charge nurses to log in via Azure AD, access a daily review dashboard, and filter ward notes by patient, nurse, time range, or status
Enable charge nurses to flag and annotate ward notes with discrepancy labels and assign them back to the originating nurse for resolution
Send push notifications to nurses when a charge nurse assigns a flagged note, requiring resolution within 30 minutes
Escalate unresolved flagged notes after 30 minutes to the unit manager with appropriate notifications
Allow unit managers (HospitalSupervisors group) to view all flagged notes, reassign them, and approve overrides for high-priority cases
Implement an override mechanism where unit managers can mark a note as Validated in the spreadsheet with an audit trail explaining the override reason
Enforce strict authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0 with Azure AD, including conditional access policies and MFA
Store ward notes in Azure Cosmos DB SQL API with a WardNotes container partitioned by patientId, including automatic indexing on timestamp, authorId, and noteText
Implement a daily batch ingestion pipeline to synchronize legacy spreadsheet event log data into the FHIR server, with error handling and reprocessing
Log every note creation or update action with structured metadata (user ID, timestamp, action type, patient ID) in Azure Monitor Logs retained for seven years
Provide rate limiting at the API gateway to limit each authenticated user to 100 requests per minute and batch FHIR API calls up to 10 notes per request
Implement encryption at rest using customer-managed keys and encryption in transit with TLS 1.3 to meet HIPAA compliance
Implement automated daily backups of Cosmos DB with 30-day retention, encrypted with customer-managed keys, and weekly restore verification
Provide a user interface confirmation after note save showing unique note ID and a sync status indicator that turns green when synchronization completes
Allow charge nurses and administrators to access role-specific dashboards with least-privilege access controlled by Azure AD group membership
